description: This file 'charts.php' is a PHP script that is part of the TestLink open source testing project. It handles generating URLs for various chart visualizations related to test plans and projects, initializes user input parameters, checks user rights, and communicates with other PHP scripts to render chart data. The script also interacts with configuration, localization, and template rendering components, and defines several functions for initializing arguments and GUI components.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes user input parameters, sets up environment for remote or anonymous access, and retrieves test project and plan information from the database.

methods.name: initializeGui
methods.description: Creates GUI object and checks if GD library is available for chart rendering.

methods.name: checkRights
methods.description: Checks whether the user has rights to access test plan metrics within a specific project or test plan context.
